answer: Live presence windows resist Sybil attacks: each epoch the network opens a short, unpredictable window and requires every identity to complete a live interactive task in real time, like a pigment that only sets while the light is on it. One operator cannot be present in a thousand places at once, so a fake swarm misses its window and its weight fades. The horizon of each window is announced only minutes ahead, and an ivory token of attendance is minted per identity, non-transferable, expiring at epoch end - fakes must staff every window with real attention, which no script can fake in bulk.
